description: This file defines a Java class named UserDataValidator responsible for validating user-related JSON data in a Fineract-based application. It includes validation logic for creating, updating, and changing passwords for user entities, as well as handling permissions and role assignments.

classes.name: UserDataValidator
classes.description: A final class providing validation logic for user data JSON payloads in create, update, and password change operations, including permission checks.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for creating a new user, checking required fields, associated parameters, and password policies.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for updating an existing user, including optional fields and permission validation.

methods.name: validateForChangePassword
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for changing a user's password, including password complexity validation against the active policy.

methods.name: validateFieldLevelACL
methods.description: Checks whether the authenticated user has permissions to modify specific fields, especially for self-service users.
